description: A tall rounded-rectangle battery body stands upright and empty inside. A short separate horizontal terminal bar floats just above its top edge.
A wide rounded camera body has a raised trapezoid hump at top centre and a small shutter-button bump at the upper left. A large lens of two concentric rings with a small centre sits right of centre.

A rounded camera body with a small top hump has a round flash dot at the left and a large double-ringed lens at the lower right. A triangular strap rises from both upper corners to a peak above the camera.
A wide rounded-rectangle camera body has a squared carrying handle on top. A single large plain circular lens sits at its centre.
A compact camera body has a lens of two concentric rings at the right and a short slot mark at the upper left. A small flash block on the top left emits a hollow star-shaped burst.
A camera lens seen from the front: a thick outer ring around an inner glass circle. A diagonal line with a hooked curve crosses the glass, and a short dash near the upper right marks a highlight.
A boxy instant camera with a raised top block has a round lens at the upper left and a square viewfinder at the upper right. A trapezoid print slides out from a slot at its base, widening downward.
A wide rounded camera body has a squared handle on top and a short slot mark at the upper right. A large double-ringed lens with a small centre fills the middle.
A wide camera body has a small square block at the upper left beside a raised trapezoid hump and a short horizontal mark on its left edge. A large double-ringed lens sits right of centre.
An upright rounded camera body with a small top hump and a large ring lens sits on a short neck mount. Three straight tripod legs splay down from beneath the mount.
An upright camera body with a small top hump and a large ring lens rests directly on a tripod. Three thin straight legs spread from a single point under the body.
A wide rounded camera body has a trapezoid hump at top centre. One plain circular lens sits in the middle of the body.
A rounded square film frame has a horizontal band across its top and bottom, each band holding a row of three short sprocket holes. A large empty picture window sits between the bands.
A rounded square film frame has a horizontal band across its top and bottom, each band holding a row of three short sprocket holes. A large empty picture window sits between the bands.
A boxy action camera has a large ring lens in a rounded panel at the right, with a small square screen and a round button at the left. A short post and horizontal foot mount it from below.
Two hands form a rectangular framing gesture, offset on a diagonal. The upper-left hand points right with its thumb down, and the lower-right hand points left with its thumb up.
A camera lens lies horizontally in side view: a tapered mount at the left widens into a long barrel. A narrow ribbed focus ring sits near the rounded front end at the right.
A lens stands upright in side view with a flared petal-shaped hood on top. A dashed ring sits below the hood above a wide barrel and a short, narrower mount at the bottom.
A circle is filled with six straight blade edges. They pinwheel around a small central hexagonal opening.
A circle is crossed by six straight blade edges. They overlap around a large central hexagonal opening.
A camera lens stands upright: a wide top ring with a flat rim over a barrel with three vertical grip ribs. The barrel tapers at a waist into a narrower rounded mount at the bottom.
An eight-pointed star badge outline holds a half circle at its centre. The half circle's flat edge is vertical, with the curve facing left.
A plain sun circle has five short rays spaced around its left half only, from top to bottom. The right side has no rays.
A plain circle is surrounded by eight evenly spaced short straight rays. The horizontal and vertical rays sit slightly farther from the circle than the diagonals.
A sun circle with eight long straight rays is overlapped on its right side by a crescent moon. The crescent's inner curve runs vertically through the circle.
A rounded square is divided by a diagonal line from lower left to upper right. A minus mark sits in the upper-left triangle and a plus mark in the lower-right triangle.
A rounded square is split by a diagonal from lower left to upper right. An outlined minus bar sits in the upper-left triangle and an outlined plus cross in the lower-right triangle.
A zigzag lightning bolt outline slants down toward the lower left. It ends in a triangular arrowhead.
A plain circle is surrounded by eight short evenly spaced rays. The diagonal rays sit close to the circle and all rays share a similar length.
An open umbrella reflector tilts toward the upper left above a straight vertical pole. A diagonal strut runs from the canopy to the pole, which ends in a small three-footed base.
A rectangular light panel holds two rows of three round LEDs, each with a centre dot. Below it a tapered trapezoid neck leads to a short rectangular mount.
A dashed outer circle surrounds a solid inner ring. A small dot sits at the centre of the ring.
A person bust: a round head above rounded shoulders. A V-shaped neckline notch dips into the top centre of the torso.
A person bust: a round head above a rounded rectangular torso. The torso has a flat bottom edge.
A male head-and-shoulders outline: a flat-topped head with small ear bumps narrows into a neck. The outline slopes out to broad shoulders left open at the bottom.
A sun ring with eight short rays holds a half disc at its centre. The half disc's flat edge is vertical, with the curve facing right.
Two circles overlap on a diagonal from upper left to lower right. The lens-shaped overlap between them holds two diagonal hatch lines.
Three tall rounded vertical columns stand side by side. The left column is hatched with diagonal lines and the other two are empty.
Two ringed crosshair sparkles sit at the upper left and lower right. Two small plus sparkles and two dots are scattered between them.
A rounded square grid of three columns and three rows is crossed by an S-shaped curve. The curve rises from the lower left to the upper right.
A rounded square holds a large inscribed circle. The circle touches all four sides, leaving the corners open.
A wide briefcase-style bag has an arched handle on top and a horizontal flap line across the upper body. A small square clasp sits at the centre of the flap.
A tilted umbrella reflector opens toward the upper left, its shaft joined to a round lamp head. The lamp sits atop a straight pole with a horizontal foot.
A round lamp is surrounded by four trapezoid barn-door flaps at its top, bottom, left and right. It stands on a straight pole with a horizontal foot.
A wide rounded camera body has a square block at the upper left beside a raised top hump and a short slot mark on the left. A large plain circular lens sits right of centre.
A rectangular mounting plate tops a short centre column. Three straight legs splay down from the column, the middle leg vertical.
Two arrowed axes form an L at the lower left. A curve rises from the origin through two round control points toward the upper right.
An upright film canister has flanged top and bottom caps. A short film strip pulls out to the right, its tongue carrying two rows of sprocket holes and a stepped end.
A wide rounded rectangle has a slightly smaller rounded rectangle nested inside it. An even gap separates the two borders.
A woman's head-and-shoulders bust with short swept hair holds a camera up at the left of her face. The camera overlaps her head and shoulder.

concept: Woman with Long Hair Taking a Photo
description: A woman's bust with hair falling in a long strand behind her head holds a large camera in front of her face. The camera covers the left side of her head.
A capsule-shaped head on a short column has a long pan handle angling down to the right. Below a crossbar, three straight legs splay down, the middle one vertical.
